docs.summary: Records deterministic review-only handoff metadata for future Locus and Multiverse consumer-owned conformance work while UI, browser, rendering, import/export commands, consumer runners, runtime, command, storage, connector, Fabric, websocket/http, MCP/task, Secure Drop, service discovery, scheduling, filesystem/process control, and external lookups remain blocked.
Provides the preceding consumer display fixture example pack referenced by Phase 5.52.
Provides the preceding consumer display fixture schema boundary referenced by Phase 5.52.

machineReadableArtifacts.summary: Records ten metadata-only conformance handoff entries with Phase 5.50 schema references, Phase 5.51 example fixture references, future consumer-side validation responsibilities, false authorization flags, unsafe import/execution flags, and non-authorizing proof.

tests.summary: Pins the Phase 5.52 helper, fixture shape, Phase 5.50/5.51 references, fail-closed unsafe cases, blocked import/export and runner commands, and runtime source guards.
Pins the Phase 5.52 status inventory, docs cross-links, fixture inventory, and import/export/rendering/runtime-disabled posture.
